content: In which file are the OAuth consumer key and secret used by the CLI defined?

The defaults are defined in `src/config/config.js`. The schema declares `OAUTH_CONSUMER_KEY` and `OAUTH_CONSUMER_SECRET` at `src/config/config.js:13-14`, and their default values are set at `src/config/config.js:77` and `src/config/config.js:82`. The schema marks both as optional, so a custom environment can override them, for example with `clever login --oauth-consumer-secret`.

These are public credentials on purpose. They identify the CLI as an OAuth client and don't belong to any user, so they aren't a leak.
